evidence:
Static/config review of the frozen task (.qc-cache/hireops-lessons-2026-10-08-r3/task) against workbook Quality Checks row 47 (A48/C48/D48), Internal Quality Checks row 47, SKILL.md delivery profile and references/quality-checks.md section 47.
(1) Shared pinned judge agent + model: task/task.toml [verifier.env] is byte-identical to the frozen block in references/staged-task-contract.md (REWARDKIT_JUDGE="claude-code", REWARDKIT_MODEL="z-ai/glm-5.3-flashx", ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL="https://openrouter.ai/api", ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN="${OPENROUTER_API_KEY}", ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=""); diff against rules/projects/webdev-task-template/task.toml differs only in name/description/keywords/difficulty/provenance/arena_slice. All five judge.toml files (gates/render, gates/constraints, scored/functional, scored/polish, scored/visual) carry only judge = "claude-code" fallback, mode=batched, isolated=false, prompt_template=prompt.md; grep for ^\s*(model|reasoning_effort|temperature)\s*= finds nothing; no [judge].weight.
(2) Pinned judge CLIs and browser: task/tests/Dockerfile is byte-identical to the template tests/Dockerfile (diff empty): @anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.281, @openai/codex@0.151.0, @playwright/mcp@0.0.79 (Chromium installed via that package's bundled playwright cli.js, line 34-35, symlinked to /usr/local/bin/chromium used by every judge.toml --executable-path), harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7, express@5.1.0, better-sqlite3@12.4.1; bases node:22-bookworm-slim and python:3.12-slim are tag-pinned (template-controlled); apt packages unpinned, which the workbook (Deterministic row on Dockerfiles) treats as NOTE only.
(3) Shared tools builds: tests/tools/score.py, tests/tools/restart_mcp.py, tests/test.sh and tests/.dockerignore are byte-identical to the frozen template (diff -q).
(4) Graded time rules on a fixed clock: the brief and notes contain no calendar/date-based graded rule (grep of instruction.md, environment/instructions/*.md, app_context.md for clock/date/today/ago/overdue/deadline/expire finds only the 15-second live-update latency at instruction.md:5 and hireops_rules.md:122). Unread/seen state is count-based (seed reads use read_count, not timestamps); message paging and Activity order are by id in the golden (solution/app/src/index.js:189,407,411-412); wall clock (index.js:59 now()) only stamps records and is never compared against the seed's July 2026 created_at values for a graded figure. The 15-second latency is measured relatively inside one browser_run_code_unsafe action (t0 = Date.now(), 500 ms polling, void/repeat rule up to two more attempts) at tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:21 and the polish prompt, so it does not depend on run date. Hence no fixed clock is needed and none is missing.
(5) Lessons file patterns bearing on this row: lesson 7/14 (timing race, void/repeat) handled as above; lesson 13 (no public internet address in judge prompts) - grep of tests/ for http(s) URLs other than localhost/127.0.0.1 finds none; lesson 11 (judge infra crashes) is runtime, not a pinning defect. Network public: open verifier network / no allowlist is explicitly NOT a defect per D48.
Workbook conflict recorded: Internal Quality Checks D48 still says 'Pinned model, temperature 0, versioned prompt, pinned browser, and no unpinned network in the scoring path'; the client Quality Checks D48 and the skill (SKILL.md delivery profile; quality-checks.md 47 Note) supersede it: temperature and prompt-version markers are not required and a temperature key in judge.toml would itself be a defect. Not counted against the task.
Adversarial: a broken app cannot exploit pinning; a conforming app ordering messages by created_at would still order correctly since run-date wall clock (Oct 2026+) is after all seed timestamps; an app using second-resolution timestamps for Activity order could tie, but ordering is graded as product behaviour (row-level, not this row) and the golden uses ids.
Evidence limits: static review only; no configured judge run, Oracle or model score exists (raw-evidence-index.json scope says full configured grading is absent); LLM judge run-to-run variance is not measured, but the row does not require a temperature setting. The base-image tags and apt packages are template-controlled and cannot be changed by the task.
